title: Rapid quench transfer from a box furnace: requirements for buyer-supplied baskets and water tanks
summary: Buyer-supplied baskets and water tanks affect whether rapid transfer is feasible. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s March 2024 high-temperature box-furnace proposal uses internal blocks to support workpieces and a rail-mounted fork-handling machine for loading and extraction. Baskets and the tank are buyer-supplied, while furnace loading and handling-machine capacity have different definitions. Check all interfaces on one loading/transfer drawing.
